ideas.title: Investigation into Minneapolis shooting of Alex Pretti
ideas.description: This story would investigate the circumstances surrounding the shooting of Alex Pretti by federal agents in Minneapolis, including the tactics used by agents and the response of local law enforcement.
ideas.angle: Accountability and transparency in law enforcement
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting?
Were federal agents justified in their actions?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it highlights the need for accountability and transparency in law enforcement, particularly in incidents involving federal agents. It also raises questions about the tactics used by federal agents and the impact on community trust.

ideas.title: Republican concerns over federal agents tactics in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would explore the concerns expressed by Republicans over the tactics used by federal agents in Minnesota, including the shooting of Alex Pretti.
ideas.angle: Partisan debate over law enforcement tactics
questions: What are the concerns of Republicans over federal agents tactics?
How will this impact the debate over law enforcement reform?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it highlights the partisan debate over law enforcement tactics and the need for accountability and transparency in such incidents.
